sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 660. Deals physical damage 5 times that penetrates any nullifying or invulnerability effects with a success value of 100. (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Burial Eclipse (decreases all stats by 40%, decreases physical and magic Ability Power by 100, and increases Ability Power of damage taken by 50) to the enemy field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Fire and Star Defense from Unison Damage +600
